title: AI Agents Just Invented Their Own Language (Humanity Is Locked Out)
description:
Researchers found 518 proposals for secret AI agent languages — some designed specifically to hide what they're saying from humans.

In this video, we break down:
- Gibberlink Mode: the viral hackathon demo where two AI agents switched from English to sound-based communication
- The Moltbook Files: a 2026 arXiv paper studying 518 emergent language proposals from autonomous agents
- Secret Collusion: how AI agents hide messages in normal-looking text (steganography)
- Emergent Cyber Behavior: AI agents autonomously hacking systems they manage
- The platform problem: why this matters for your data

This isn't science fiction. It's published research from arXiv, NeurIPS, and Irregular.

Sources:
- arXiv 2605.31170: Emergent Languages in Populations of Language Model Agents (2026)
- Motwani et al., NeurIPS 2024: Secret Collusion Among AI Agents
- Irregular Research: Emergent Cyber Behavior (March 2026)
- ElevenLabs Hackathon: Gibberlink Mode (Feb 2025)
- Forbes, Infobip, Wikipedia coverage
